data: In fiscal 2023, the year ended January 29, 2023, NVIDIA reported revenue of about $26.97 billion, essentially flat from $26.91 billion in fiscal 2022. Gross profit was roughly $15.36 billion, a GAAP gross margin of 56.9%, down from 64.9% in fiscal 2022. The decline was largely due to inventory provisions of about $2.17 billion tied to weaker gaming and data center demand forecasts. Operating income was about $4.22 billion, an operating margin of roughly 15.7%, down sharply from $10.04 billion (37.3%) the prior year. That drop reflected the lower gross margin, higher operating expenses, and a $1.35 billion charge for the terminated Arm acquisition. Note that NVIDIA's fiscal 2023 mostly covers calendar 2022, so it comes before the AI-driven surge that began in fiscal 2024.
